#### **Required Implementation:**
```rust
pub async fn extract_text_from_file(file_content: &[u8], content_type: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    match content_type {
        "application/pdf" => {
            PdfExtractor::extract_text_from_bytes(file_content)
                .map_err(|e| format!("PDF extraction failed: {}", e))
        },
        _ => Err("Unsupported file type".to_string()),
    }
}
```

### **File: `src/api/src/handlers/file.rs`**

#### **Current (INCOMPLETE):**

#### **Required Implementation:**
```rust
pub async fn store_uploaded_file(file_data: Vec<u8>, filename: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let storage_service = StorageService::new().await?;
    let doc_metadata = DocumentMetadata {
        filename: filename.to_string(),
        size: file_data.len(),
        upload_time: chrono::Utc::now(),
    };

    let doc_id = storage_service.store_document(&file_data, &doc_metadata).await
        .map_err(|e| format!("Storage failed: {}", e))?;

    Ok(doc_id)
}
```

## 🧪 TESTING IMPLEMENTATION REQUIRED

### **File: `tests/integration/pdf_processing.rs` (CREATE)**
```rust
#[tokio::test]
async fn test_end_to_end_pdf_processing() {
    // Test real PDF upload and processing
    let pdf_bytes = std::fs::read("tests/fixtures/sample_compliance.pdf").unwrap();

    // Upload PDF
    let upload_result = upload_pdf(pdf_bytes, "sample.pdf").await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(upload_result.status, "processed");

    // Query the document
    let query_result = query_document(&upload_result.doc_id, "What are the password requirements?").await.unwrap();

    // Validate response
    assert!(!query_result.answer.is_empty());
    assert!(!query_result.citations.is_empty());
    assert!(query_result.confidence > 0.8);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn test_pdf_error_handling() {
    // Test corrupted PDF
    let corrupted_pdf = vec![0x00; 1024]; // Invalid PDF data
    let result = upload_pdf(corrupted_pdf, "corrupted.pdf").await;
    assert!(result.is_err());

    // Test oversized PDF
    let large_pdf = vec![0x25; 100_000_000]; // 100MB of data
    let result = upload_pdf(large_pdf, "large.pdf").await;
    // Should either process or fail gracefully
    match result {
        Ok(r) => assert_eq!(r.status, "processed"),
        Err(e) => assert!(e.contains("file too large")),
    }
}
```
